Power of the one-way analysis of variance

Source: R/pwranv.R
pwranv.Rd

The power of the F test of equal means in k groups of n with Cohen's effect size f (the standard deviation of the group means about their mean, over the common standard deviation), from the noncentral F distribution; or, given the power wanted, the smallest whole n per group that reaches it.

Usage

pwranv(k, n = NULL, f, alpha = 0.05, power = NULL)

Arguments

k

The number of groups: a whole number from 2 to 1000000.

n

NULL, or the sizes of each group to try: numbers above 1, at most 10000000.

f

The effect sizes to try: numbers from 0.

alpha

The level of the test: one number strictly between 0 and 1.

power

NULL, or the power wanted: one number above alpha and below 1. Give one of n and power.

Value

A data frame, one row per n and f (n varying fastest), or per f with power: k, n, f, df1, df2, ncp, fcrit and power.

Details

The statistic has df1 = k - 1 and df2 = k (n - 1) degrees of freedom and noncentrality ncp = k n f^2 (Cohen 1988, ch. 8); the power is the chance that it passes fcrit, the upper alpha quantile of the central F. The noncentral upper tail is the Poisson mixture of beta upper tails (Johnson, Kotz and Balakrishnan 1995, ch. 30). With power, n is searched over the whole numbers from 2 to 10000000; where no such n reaches it (f = 0, or too small an effect) the row is NA from df2 on. Cohen's conventions are 0.1, 0.25 and 0.4 for a small, medium and large effect.

References

Cohen, J. (1988). Statistical Power Analysis for the Behavioral Sciences, 2nd ed. Lawrence Erlbaum. doi:10.4324/9780203771587

Johnson, N. L., Kotz, S. and Balakrishnan, N. (1995). Continuous Univariate Distributions, vol. 2, 2nd ed. Wiley.

Examples

pwranv(3, n = c(20, 40, 60), f = 0.25)
#>   k  n    f df1 df2   ncp    fcrit     power
#> 1 3 20 0.25   2  57  3.75 3.158843 0.3744311
#> 2 3 40 0.25   2 117  7.50 3.073763 0.6756745
#> 3 3 60 0.25   2 177 11.25 3.047012 0.8546381
pwranv(4, f = c(0.1, 0.25, 0.4), power = 0.8)
#>   k   n    f df1  df2   ncp    fcrit     power
#> 1 4 274 0.10   3 1092 10.96 2.613053 0.8007324
#> 2 4  45 0.25   3  176 11.25 2.655939 0.8039869
#> 3 4  19 0.40   3   72 12.16 2.731807 0.8234006
